source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: ConversationView creates its own DOMLocalization and connects the newly created shadow root during the first connectedCallback. Its disconnectedCallback disconnects that same root. This is a scoped ownership pair for this component, not proof of all listener cleanup or reconnection after reinserting an existing instance; connectedCallback still returns when a shadowRoot exists. The patch changes no tests, and no leak or UI check ran.
title: ConversationView disconnects its own localization root on removal
